kind: fixed synthetic class-prior stress diagnostic on saved held-out predictions; no training
hypothesis: Equal probability-mass balancing may lose its benefit when held-out class frequencies differ.
source_fact: Test passages per model are unequal; model mix differs between public and private leaderboards.
references: V17 sparse plus fixed 0.15 V22 SupCon
V17 sparse plus fixed 0.15 V25 CE
sampling: Rotate nine high-frequency classes through sorted label order; high classes retain 30 rows, low classes retain the first low_count rows of a fixed seeded within-class permutation. All retained rows were held out from fitting.
metric: mean per-class recall, with ordinary accuracy reported separately
restrictions: Do not treat synthetic rotations as independent replicates
